verdicts.evidence: Bright, saturated green and lime ovals fill the whole hero below the nav bar, and the white headline, subline and button sit straight on them with no calmer area behind.
The hero image is an even scatter of flat green ovals with no fern fronds, shade or greenhouse, under a headline that reads "Ferns and shade plants for every corner".

The smaller white subline "Grown on the hill and ready to plant this weekend." and the "Browse the greenhouse" button sit over the leaf pattern, and the button is only a thin white outline with no fill.
